# U117: The year ends on its last day with nobody starting the next: on 11 Jan 2027 the frame says 2026 has ended, nothing is due, late or out of date, Q4 is closed, and Cycles gives the year’s real days; started then, 2026’s wrap-up stays open

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `RESULTS`, `YEAR`
- **Budget:** 6 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `budget` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U117

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Rhea owns goals behind and one gone quiet. The example is copied into a workspace of her own (as U10 does), so it keeps 2026 when the clock moves past the year's end (the demo rebuilds its example around the day it's opened).
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `async () => { const full = await window.__goalsStore.load('platform-org'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:workspaces', JSON.stringify([{ id: 'ws_end', name: 'Year end', kind: 'own', createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' }])); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:ws_end', JSON.stringify({ ...full, changes: [] })); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-workspace', 'ws_end'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-viewer:ws_end', 'rhea'); }`.
- _Note:_ The last day: still 2026's last week, and check-ins are still due.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Sunday 3 January 2027.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/2026 · week 53, the last week/.test(lastDay)`, where `const lastDay = await p.locator('body').innerText()`. Else it says: on the last day the frame said “{frame()}”.
- _Note:_ The first day after: the year has ended by itself.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 11 January 2027.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the page’s lead is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- _Note:_ Home's lead is the wrap-up, which says the year has ended (home spec, 2.1, the wrap-up row: HM1).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/2026 has ended/.test(body) && /2026 has ended/.test(home) && /Wrap up your \d+ goals/.test(home)`, where `const home = await p.locator('main').innerText()`; `const body = await p.locator('body').innerText()`. Else it says: Home on 11 Jan 2027: “{home.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 220)}”.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `!/check-ins? to do|days late|were due|No recent update|no recent update/.test(home)`, where `const home = await p.locator('main').innerText()`. Else it says: something is still due or out of date after the year ended: “{home.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 220)}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home after the end”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Her goals: none is out of date, and Q4 has closed on the numbers there are.
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo on Monday 11 January 2027.
- **Check:** The h1 in the main (`main h1`) shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `!/No recent update/.test(goal) && !/Q4[^\n]*(In progress|plan [0-9.]+ hours by week)/.test(goal)`, where `const goal = await p.locator('main').innerText()`. Else it says: the north star’s page after the end: “{goal.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 220)}”.
- _Note:_ Cycles gives the year's real first and last days, and says it ended.
- Switch to Amara in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo on Monday 11 January 2027.
- **Check:** The “Cycles” list shows.
- **Check:** (`parity`) met when `/2026 · ended 3 Jan 2027/.test(row) && /29 Dec 2025 to 3 Jan 2027/.test(row)`, where `const cycles = p.getByRole('list', { name: 'Cycles' })`; `const row = (await cycles.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: Cycles: “{row.slice(0, 200)}”.
- _Note:_ After the wrap-up has closed (5 Feb 2027) an admin can still start 2027, from Cycles and from the wrap-up page (build review, 11 Nov).
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo on Friday 5 February 2027.
- **Check:** The “Cycles” list shows.
- Go to `/retro` in the demo on Friday 5 February 2027.
- **Check:** “The wrap-up closed on Sun 31 Jan 2027” is shown.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `late > 0 && fromRetro > 0`, where `const late = await p.getByRole('link', { name: 'Start 2027' }).count()`; `const fromRetro = await p.getByRole('link', { name: 'Start 2027' }).count()`. Else it says: after the wrap-up closed, Start 2027 was on Cycles {late} time(s) and on the wrap-up {fromRetro}.
- _Note:_ Started on 11 Jan 2027, 2027 is current at once and 2026's wrap-up stays open until 31 Jan (rule 3; build review of #133, high).
- Go to `/workspace/cycles/next` in the demo on Monday 11 January 2027.
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” button.
- **Check:** The “Cycles” list shows.
- Go to `/retro` in the demo on Monday 11 January 2027.
- **Check:** “2026 ended on Sun 3 Jan 2027” is shown.
- **Step.** Press the “Wrap up” link in the retro row (`.retro-row`).
- **Step.** Type “Moved more slowly than we planned” into the “What did you learn?” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/retro/?(?…)”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `wrapRows > 0 && saved && cyclesAfter > 0`, where `const on = (day, path) => BASE + '/demo' + path + (path.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'today=' + day`; `const wrapRows = await p.locator('.retro-row').count()`; `const saved = await p.getByText(/^Wrapped up /).first().isVisible().catch(() => false)`; `const cyclesAfter = await (async () => { await p.goto(on('2027-01-11', '/workspace/cycles')); const l = p.getByRole('list', { name: 'Cycles' }); await l.waitFor(); return l.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open the wrap-up' }).count(); })()`. Else it says: with 2027 current on 11 Jan, 2026’s wrap-up showed {wrapRows} goals, saving said “Wrapped up” {saved}, and Cycles offered 2026’s wrap-up {cyclesAfter} time(s).
- **Check:** (`logged`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
